name: Portfolio
description: A polished single-page personal/creative portfolio with hero intro, about, case-study project grid, skills, contact form, and footer.
usage: Open index.html in a browser to preview, or deploy it as-is to any static host. Swap the placeholder name (Maya Solano), copy, projects, and contact details for your own; recolor by editing the inline tailwind.config palette. No build step — it runs on the Tailwind Play CDN with vanilla JS for the mobile nav, scroll reveals, skill bars, scroll-spy, and demo contact form.
